title: xyris glabrata
intro: Xyris glabrata, commonly known as the yellow-eyed grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Xyridaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and aiding in the regulation of body temperature. The therapeutic actions of Xyris glabrata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic activities, which contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
